## SIGNATURE PAGE (For Account Opening)  
**Customer Acknowledgment:**  
I have read and agree to these Terms & Conditions for the SmartSaver Account.  
I confirm:
- I am 18+ years old
- I provide accurate information
- I understand the variable interest rate
- I accept liability for joint accounts (if applicable)  
---  
**Customer Name (Print):** ____________________
**Customer Signature:** ________________________
**Date:** ____________________  
---  
**For Joint Accounts:**  
**Joint Holder Name (Print):** ____________________
**Joint Holder Signature:** ________________________
**Date:** ____________________  
---

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account
raw_entities.description: A savings product offered by FirstUK Bank for which customers must acknowledge and agree to Terms & Conditions at account opening. The product features a variable interest rate and supports joint account arrangements.
context: I have read and agree to these Terms & Conditions for the SmartSaver Account.
I understand the variable interest rate
I accept liability for joint accounts (if applicable)

raw_entities.name: Minimum Age Requirement
raw_entities.description: Customers must be 18 years of age or older to open and hold a SmartSaver Account. This is confirmed by the customer at account opening via signature.
context: I am 18+ years old

raw_entities.name: Accurate Information Requirement
raw_entities.description: Customers must provide accurate information as a condition of account opening and ongoing account holding. This is confirmed by the customer at signature.
context: I provide accurate information

raw_entities.name: Variable Interest Rate
raw_entities.description: The SmartSaver Account offers a variable interest rate that customers must understand and accept as a condition of account opening.
context: I understand the variable interest rate

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Liability Provision
raw_entities.description: A contractual provision governing liability for joint account holders. Customers acknowledge and accept liability for joint accounts where applicable at account opening.
context: I accept liability for joint accounts (if applicable)

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Arrangement
raw_entities.description: An optional account arrangement under the SmartSaver Account product where two or more customers may hold the account jointly. Joint holders must provide signatures and acknowledgment of terms at account opening.
context: For Joint Accounts:
I accept liability for joint accounts (if applicable)

raw_entities.name: Primary Account Holder
raw_entities.description: The primary customer who opens and holds the SmartSaver Account. The primary holder must confirm their identity, age, and agreement to terms via signature at account opening.
context: Customer Name (Print):

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Holder
raw_entities.description: A secondary customer who holds the SmartSaver Account jointly with the primary holder. Joint holders must provide their name and signature at account opening and accept liability for the joint account.
context: Joint Holder Name (Print):
Joint Holder Signature:

raw_entities.description: The overarching contractual framework governing the SmartSaver Account. Customers must read and agree to these terms as a mandatory condition of account opening, confirmed by signature.
context: I have read and agree to these Terms & Conditions for the SmartSaver Account.
